issues.title: sep TB load to blackline dropped accounts with no activity
issues.description:
BD1 trial balance load for SEP-26 came into BlackLine with 412 accounts. Oracle TB has 449 with a balance. The 37 missing all carry a balance but had no September activity, so their recs show a zero GL balance and can't be certified.

Expected: every account with an ending balance loads, activity or not.

Needed before rec approvals on BD5 (Wed 10/7).

issues.title: AP BD1 feed run failed: GL-INT-4471
issues.description:

```
GL-INT-4471 Invalid code combination 2010-000-410-0000 - cost center 410 end-dated 10/31/2026. Batch rolled back: 0 of 1,284 lines posted ($612,384.27).
```

Screenshot saved to `/Finance/Close/2026-10/Evidence/Systems/AP_feed_error_2026-11-02.png`

Morning,

- fix: `ending_balance <> 0 OR period_activity <> 0`

Monday's load looks right. Spot-checked 6 of the 37 against Oracle, all tie ✅

Thanks. That covers BD1 on 11/2 for the October close too.

Found the cause. Cost center 410 was end-dated by the Memphis re-org hierarchy load. Fixing the mapping.

Repro:
1. Run `XXGL_COA_VALIDATE` on batch `SAPAP-20261102-01` (1,284 lines, $612,384.27)
2. Lines coded to `2010-000-410-0000` fail validation, so the whole batch rolls back
3. The CC 410 end date (10/31/2026) came in with the 10/30 hierarchy load

Plan: remap 410 to 415 in the SAP-to-GL crosswalk, rerun in TEST, then PROD.
